test_title: PYST 55: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select ‘No error’.**

Time is the greater / eraser, both of / sorrow and of joy.
solution:
The correct answer is option no.(2) **'Time is the greater'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The grammatical error is in the first part of the sentence.
 
• The first part of the sentence **'Time is the greater'** has an error.
 
• **There is an error of adjective or degree of adjective.**
 
• In the given part '**the'** is hint for finding error because **article 'the**'is used before superlative degree but here** greater(comparative degree) **has been used with** article 'the' (e.g. - **It was** the best **__moment for us.)
 
• The part will be corrected by adding superlative degree after article the.
 
• **'Time is the greatest' **will be the correct phrase.

Therefore, the correct answer is option no**.(2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 and 3 have no error - **eraser,both of** and **sorrow and of joy **are grammatically correct.
 
• **Both------and** is the correct pair.
